tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review Mira Thimblefern's expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before client discussion. Show how much of the $3.71 million sale cash should remain available for taxes, household reserves, mortgage decisions, charitable gifts, and staged portfolio reinvestment, with two years of household spending kept in low-volatility accounts.
tickets.evidence: For the liquidity plan for business sale proceeds, Mira asked for an analysis showing how much sale cash should remain available for taxes, household reserves, mortgage decisions, charitable gifts, and staged portfolio reinvestment; the agreed follow-up is due September 5, 2025.

tickets.title: Collect closing packet documents for business sale
tickets.text: Collect the final closing statement, escrow schedule, and post-closing adjustment worksheet for Mira Thimblefern's Paper Otter Packaging LLC sale to Copper Firefly Holdings so net proceeds and escrow treatment can be verified.
tickets.evidence: For the closing packet for the business sale, the final closing statement, escrow schedule, and post-closing adjustment worksheet were not yet in Mira’s planning file, and those documents are needed to verify net proceeds and escrow treatment by August 29, 2025.

tickets.title: Reconcile net proceeds variance for business sale
tickets.text: Trace the difference between the broker's estimated net cash and the $3.71 million wire that reached Mira Thimblefern's Teacup Comet Bank checking account to fees, debt payoff, escrow, or a separate expected transfer.
tickets.evidence: For the net proceeds variance, the broker’s proceeds memo showed a higher estimated net cash amount than the actual incoming bank wire, and the difference needs to be traced to fees, debt payoff, escrow, or a separate expected transfer by August 27, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate CPA review of estimated taxes
tickets.text: Coordinate with Tobin Mossbutton of Apricot Compass Tax to compare Mira Thimblefern's sale proceeds, transition consulting income, withholding, and expected deductions before the next estimated tax planning decision.
tickets.evidence: For CPA coordination on estimated taxes, Mira wants the advisory team and Tobin Mossbutton to compare sale proceeds, consulting income, withholding, and expected deductions before the next estimated tax planning decision; the agreed follow-up is due September 12, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain replacement health coverage details
tickets.text: Gather premium, deductible, and eligibility details for replacement health coverage for Mira Thimblefern before her former company coverage ends after the transition period, so an option can be chosen.
tickets.evidence: For health coverage after the operating role ends, Mira’s former company coverage is expected to end after the transition period, and premium, deductible, and eligibility details for replacement coverage are needed before choosing an option by September 20, 2025.

tickets.title: Resolve Teacup Comet Bank transfer hold
tickets.text: Resolve the temporary limit Teacup Comet Bank placed on outbound online transfers from Mira Thimblefern's checking account that received the $3.71 million sale wire, so excess cash can move to custody or treasury vehicles.
tickets.evidence: For the bank transfer hold on sale proceeds, Mira reported that Teacup Comet Bank temporarily limited outbound online transfers from the account that received the sale wire, preventing efficient movement of excess cash to custody or treasury vehicles; the agreed follow-up is due August 25, 2025.

tickets.title: Request estate document collection
tickets.text: Ask Mira Thimblefern to provide current estate documents, including wills, trusts, powers of attorney, health care directives, and any recent amendment pages, so the advisory team can update planning records. The estate file still references the operating business interest in Paper Otter Packaging LLC and lacks current signed copies of post-sale amendments or fiduciary updates.
tickets.evidence: For the estate file update after sale, the advisory review found that the estate file on record still references the operating business interest and lacks current signed copies of any post-sale amendments or fiduciary updates; the agreed follow-up is due September 10, 2025.
